title: Draw the Place · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Draw the Place · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a list of familiar places such as a beach or library. The lead draws three objects commonly found in one selected place. The others identify the place from the three clues. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Draw the Place, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The others identify the place from the three clues.
recall.why: The others identify the place from the three clues.
